Name: FS academia-style Shoes
Author: tsuki225
Description:
These cute shoes are made specifically for the DoEun'sFemaleBody type, as this is my personal favorite body shape.
They can also be worn on other body shapes, but minor model clipping might happen.
If you are using the DoEun'sFemaleBody, please set its style to the design shown in the second screenshot when equipping the shoes.
